# Circular histagram plot
```{r}
# long format for figure
data <- surveyscores %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "survey", values_to = "scores") 

# normalise each survey so histograms chunks are equal size
data <- data %>%
  group_by(survey) %>%
  mutate(scores = as.vector(scale(scores))) %>%  # Convert back to vector
  ungroup()

# Set up the PNG device to save the image
png("~/Git/InteroMentalHealth/figures/TaskFigs/surveyscores_summary_withmaia_notext.png", width = 1600, height = 1600)  # 

circos.clear()

circos.initialize(factors = data$survey, x = data$scores)


hist_colors <- setNames(c("#B5DBFF", "#7BB8F0", "#4F89E6", "#A78CD9", "#C58AE8", "#AB5AAC", "#E678AD", "#CF4D6F", "#B0415D"), unique_surveys <- unique(data$survey))

circos.par("track.height" = 0.225)
circos.trackPlotRegion(factors = data$survey, y = data$scores, bg.lwd = 3, bg.col = hist_colors[data$survey], panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    sector_name <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")  # Get sector name
    xlim <- get.cell.meta.data("xlim")  # Get x-axis limits
    ylim <- get.cell.meta.data("ylim")  # Get y-axis limits
    
    label <- sub(" \\(", "\n(", sector_name)
    
    # Add text, facing inward
    circos.text(mean(xlim), ylim[1] + 4.25, label,
                facing = "inside", niceFacing = TRUE,
                adj = c(0.5, 0.5), cex = 4, col = "black", font = 2)

    # Add labels at the middle of each sector
    #circos.text(mean(xlim), mean(ylim), sector_name, 
                #facing = "bending.inside", niceFacing = TRUE, cex = 3.35, col = "black", font = 2)
    circos.axis(
        h = "bottom",
        major.tick = TRUE,
        labels.cex = 3.25,
        direction = "outside",
        #lwd = 2 
    )
})

circos.par("track.height" = 0.5)
#max_abs_y <- max(abs(data$y_long))
circos.trackHist(data$survey, data$scores, bg.col = "white", col = hist_colors[data$survey], lwd = 3, bg.lwd = 2) 

# Adding text to the center
text(0,0,"Survey\nScores", cex = 5, col = "#505050", font = 2)

dev.off()

```

```{r}
cutoff_rules <- list(
  "aq10"        = ~ aq10 >= 6,
  "asrs_a_sum_binary"      = ~ asrs_a_sum_binary >= 4, #(although we used combined a+b score in main analysis?)
  "mdi"         = ~ mdi >= 26,   # ≥ moderate (or ≥21 for mild depression)
  "phq9"        = ~ phq9 >= 10,  # ≥ moderate (or ≥5 for mild depression)
  "phq15"       = ~ phq15 >= 10, # ≥ medium (or ≥5 for low somatic symptoms)
  "pss"         = ~ pss >= 14,   # ≥ medium (or ≥14 for medium stress)
  "sias"        = ~ sias >= 36,
  "stai_trait"  = ~ stai_trait >= 44
)


library(purrr)
library(rlang)
library(tibble)

num_vars <- c("aq10","asrs_a_sum_binary","mdi","phq9","phq15","pss","sias","stai_trait")
psych <- psych %>%mutate(across(all_of(num_vars), as.numeric))

cutoff_counts_simple <- imap_dfr(cutoff_rules, function(fml, survey) {
  meet <- eval_tidy(fml[[2]], data = psych)

  tibble(
    survey = survey,
    below = sum(meet %in% FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    above = sum(meet %in% TRUE,  na.rm = TRUE)
  )
})

cutoff_counts_simple
```

# Mental health cut-off analyses
```{r}
## intero data preprocess
alldata <- read_csv(here::here("data", "alldata.csv"))
# preprocess slope & M-Ratio for intero tasks
# Invert scale of hrd/extero slope (so higher = steeper slope (same as RRST)) (for both intero & extero)
alldata[ ,'HRD_slope'] <- -(alldata[ ,'HRD_slope'])
alldata[ ,'HRDextero_slope'] <- -(alldata[ ,'HRDextero_slope'])

# M-Ratio: Replace negative M-Ratio values with NA 
cols_to_modify <- c("mratio_hrd", "mratio_rrst", "mratio_extero")
alldata[cols_to_modify] <- lapply(alldata[cols_to_modify], function(x) ifelse(x < 0, NA, x))

# M-Ratio: remove high outliers from M-Ratio (MAD-based outlier removal to selected columns) 
alldata[cols_to_modify] <- lapply(alldata[cols_to_modify], function(x) {
  median_x <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  mad_x <- mad(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x[abs(x - median_x) > 3 * mad_x] <- NA
  return(x) 
})

# prepare intero + survey data to correlate
colnames(alldata) <- gsub("_", ".", colnames(alldata))
cols = c("RRST.conf", "RRST.slope", "RRST.thresh", "mratio.rrst", "HRD.conf", "HRD.slope", "HRD.absthresh", "mratio.hrd", 'maia.notice', 'maia.ndistract', 'maia.nworry', 'maia.attnReg', 'maia.EmoAware', 'maia.SelfRef', 'maia.listen', 'maia.trust', 'aq10', 'asrs.a.sum.binary', 'mdi', 'phq9', 'phq15', 'pss', 'sias', 'stai.trait') #'asrs.b.sum',  'asrs.a.sum' !! (there is sum & binary sum for cut off diagnosis!!)
corrdata <- alldata[ ,cols]#[complete.cases(alldata[, cols]),] # select cols 
colnames(corrdata) <- c("RRST Conf", "RRST Slope", "RRST Thresh", "RRST MRatio", "HRDT Conf", "HRDT Slope", "HRDT Thresh", "HRDT MRatio", 'MAIA Notice', 'MAIA NotDistract', 'MAIA NotWorry', 'MAIA AttenReg', 'MAIA EmotAware', 'MAIA SelfReg', 'MAIA Listen', 'MAIA Trust', 'AQ10', 'ASRS.A', 'MDI', 'PHQ9', 'PHQ15', 'PSS', 'SIAS', 'STAI.trait') #"asrs_combined_sum" 'ASRS.B'

# select those who cross-diagnostic cut-offs only
cutoff_rules <- list(
  "AQ10"        = ~ AQ10 >= 6,
  "ASRS.A"      = ~ ASRS.A >= 4, #(although we used combined a+b score in main analysis?)
  "MDI"         = ~ MDI >= 26,   # ≥ moderate (or ≥21 for mild depression)
  "PHQ9"        = ~ PHQ9 >= 10,  # ≥ moderate (or ≥5 for mild depression)
  "PHQ15"       = ~ PHQ15 >= 10, # ≥ medium (or ≥5 for low somatic symptoms)
  "PSS"         = ~ PSS >= 14,   # ≥ medium (or ≥14 for medium stress)
  "SIAS"        = ~ SIAS >= 36,
  "STAI.trait"  = ~ STAI.trait >= 44
)
# for each survey, set that participant survey score to NA if below cutoff
corrdata_cutoff <- corrdata
for (v in names(cutoff_rules)) {
  expr <- cutoff_rules[[v]][[2]] # Extract the RHS of the formula (e.g. AQ10 >= 6)
  keep <- eval(expr, envir = corrdata_cutoff)  # Evaluate in the corrdata_cutoff environment
  keep[is.na(keep)] <- FALSE # Treat NA as not meeting cutoff
  corrdata_cutoff[[v]][!keep] <- NA # Mask values below cutoff
}

# check how many remain per survey?
sapply(names(cutoff_rules), function(v) sum(!is.na(corrdata_cutoff[[v]])))

cormatrix_full(corrdata_cutoff, "Psych Sum Scores (>Cut-Offs)", "Intero & Psych Correlations", "~/Git/InteroMentalHealth/figures/Intero_correlations/Psychsumscores_correlations/corr_PsychsumscoresCutOffs_Intero_full_asrsabinary.png")


# Mann-Whitney U tests - below & above cut-off
intero_vars <- c(
  "RRST Conf", "RRST Slope", "RRST Thresh", "RRST MRatio",
  "HRDT Conf", "HRDT Slope", "HRDT Thresh", "HRDT MRatio"
)




library(rlang)

wilcox_results <- map_df(names(cutoff_rules), function(symptom) {

  rule <- cutoff_rules[[symptom]][[2]]

  corrdata %>%
    mutate(group = rlang::eval_tidy(rule, data = cur_data())) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(intero_vars), names_to = "intero", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(intero) %>%
    summarise(
      symptom = symptom,
      n_high = sum(group & !is.na(value)),
      n_low  = sum(!group & !is.na(value)),
      p = ifelse(
        n_high > 0 & n_low > 0,
        wilcox.test(value ~ group, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
        NA_real_
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
})


```
# Save results as table
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(rlang)

wilcox_results <- map_df(names(cutoff_rules), function(symptom) {

  rule <- cutoff_rules[[symptom]][[2]]

  corrdata %>%
    mutate(group = rlang::eval_tidy(rule, data = cur_data())) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(intero_vars), names_to = "intero", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(intero) %>%
    summarise(
      symptom = symptom,

      n_high = sum(group & !is.na(value)),
      n_low  = sum(!group & !is.na(value)),

      med_high = median(value[group], na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_high = IQR(value[group], na.rm = TRUE),
      med_low  = median(value[!group], na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_low  = IQR(value[!group], na.rm = TRUE),

      test = list(
        if (n_high > 0 & n_low > 0)
          wilcox.test(value ~ group, exact = FALSE)
        else NULL
      ),

      W = ifelse(!is.null(test[[1]]),
                 unname(test[[1]]$statistic),
                 NA_real_),

      p = ifelse(!is.null(test[[1]]),
                 test[[1]]$p.value,
                 NA_real_),

      r_rb = ifelse(
        !is.null(test[[1]]),
        (2 * unname(test[[1]]$statistic)) / (n_high * n_low) - 1,
        NA_real_
      ),

      .groups = "drop"
    )
})

# FDR correction (within symptom)
wilcox_results <- wilcox_results %>%
  group_by(symptom) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()

apa_table <- wilcox_results %>%
  mutate(
    `Above cutoff: Median (IQR)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", med_high, iqr_high),
    `Below cutoff: Median (IQR)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", med_low,  iqr_low),
    W = round(W, 1),
    r_rb = round(r_rb, 2),
    p = signif(p, 3),
    p_fdr = signif(p_fdr, 3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Symptom = symptom,
    Interoceptive = intero,
    n_high, n_low,
    `Above cutoff: Median (IQR)`,
    `Below cutoff: Median (IQR)`,
    W,
    `r (rank-biserial)` = r_rb,
    p,
    `p (FDR)` = p_fdr
  )


write.csv(
  apa_table,
  "~/Git/InteroMentalHealth/figures/Intero_correlations/Psychsumscores_correlations/Wilcoxon_Intero_PsychCutoff_APA.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


```

# Table with Bayes
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(rlang)
library(BayesFactor)

wilcox_results <- map_df(names(cutoff_rules), function(symptom) {

  rule <- cutoff_rules[[symptom]][[2]]

  corrdata %>%
    mutate(group = rlang::eval_tidy(rule, data = cur_data())) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(intero_vars), names_to = "intero", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(intero) %>%
    summarise(
      symptom = symptom,
      n_high = sum(group & !is.na(value)),
      n_low  = sum(!group & !is.na(value)),
      med_high = median(value[group], na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_high = IQR(value[group], na.rm = TRUE),
      med_low  = median(value[!group], na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr_low  = IQR(value[!group], na.rm = TRUE),

      test = list(if (n_high > 0 & n_low > 0) wilcox.test(value ~ group, exact = FALSE) else NULL),
      W = ifelse(!is.null(test[[1]]), unname(test[[1]]$statistic), NA_real_),
      p = ifelse(!is.null(test[[1]]), test[[1]]$p.value, NA_real_),

      r_rb = ifelse(!is.null(test[[1]]),
                    (2 * unname(test[[1]]$statistic)) / (n_high * n_low) - 1,
                    NA_real_),

      bf01 = {
        x1 <- value[group]; x0 <- value[!group]
        x1 <- x1[is.finite(x1)]; x0 <- x0[is.finite(x0)]
        if (length(x1) > 1 && length(x0) > 1) {
          bf10 <- BayesFactor::extractBF(BayesFactor::ttestBF(x = x1, y = x0))$bf[1]
          1 / bf10
        } else NA_real_
      },

      .groups = "drop"
    )
})

wilcox_results <- wilcox_results %>%
  group_by(symptom) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()

apa_table <- wilcox_results %>%
  mutate(
    `Above cutoff: Median (IQR)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", med_high, iqr_high),
    `Below cutoff: Median (IQR)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", med_low,  iqr_low),
    W = round(W, 1),
    r_rb = round(r_rb, 2),
    p = signif(p, 3),
    p_fdr = signif(p_fdr, 3),
    bf01 = signif(bf01, 3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Symptom = symptom,
    Interoceptive = intero,
    n_high, n_low,
    `Above cutoff: Median (IQR)`,
    `Below cutoff: Median (IQR)`,
    W,
    `r (rank-biserial)` = r_rb,
    p,
    `p (FDR)` = p_fdr,
    `BF01 (null)` = bf01
  )

write.csv(
  apa_table,
  "~/Git/InteroMentalHealth/figures/Intero_correlations/Psychsumscores_correlations/Wilcoxon_Intero_PsychCutoff_APA_Bayes.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

# Clinical cut-off boxplots
```{r}
library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(rlang)
library(ggplot2); library(tidyr)

cols <- list(
  HRDT = c(Below="#F4A6A6", Above="#B22222"),
  RRST = c(Below="#9ADBE8", Above="#1F78B4")
)

symptom_labs_nl <- c(
  AQ10       = "Autism\n(AQ10)",
  ASRS.A     = "ADHD\n(ASRS.A)",
  MDI        = "Depression\n(MDI)",
  PHQ15      = "Somatic\n(PHQ15)",
  PHQ9       = "Depression\n(PHQ9)",
  PSS        = "Stress\n(PSS)",
  SIAS       = "Social anxiety\n(SIAS)",
  STAI.trait = "Trait anxiety\n(STAI)"
)

mk_box_both <- function(vars, interolabel){

  df <- imap_dfr(cutoff_rules, \(f, s)
    corrdata |>
      mutate(symptom = s, g = eval_tidy(f[[2]], data = cur_data())) |>
      filter(!is.na(g)) |>
      pivot_longer(all_of(vars), names_to="task", values_to="value") |>
      filter(!is.na(value)) |>
      transmute(
        symptom,
        task = trimws(task),
        group = factor(if_else(g,"Above","Below"), levels=c("Below","Above")),
        value
      )
  ) |>
    mutate(task_group = interaction(task, group, sep = "_", drop = TRUE))

  pal <- setNames(
    c(cols$HRDT["Below"], cols$HRDT["Above"], cols$RRST["Below"], cols$RRST["Above"]),
    c(paste0(vars[1], "_Below"), paste0(vars[1], "_Above"),
      paste0(vars[2], "_Below"), paste0(vars[2], "_Above"))
  )

  task_labs <- c(
    setNames(paste0("Cardiac\n(", vars[1], ")"), vars[1]), # "Cardiac\n(HRDT Absolute Thresh)", vars[1]), #
    setNames(paste0("Respiratory\n(", vars[2], ")"), vars[2])
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(group, value, fill=task_group, colour=task_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(width=.45, outlier.shape=NA, alpha=.55) +
    geom_point(position=position_jitter(width=.10, height=.02),
               alpha=.25, size=1.1) +
    facet_grid(
      task ~ symptom, scales="free_y", switch="y",
      labeller = labeller(task = task_labs, symptom = symptom_labs_nl)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
    labs(y = interolabel, x = "Clinical cut-off group") +
    theme_classic(base_size=17) +
    theme(
      legend.position="none",
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      strip.text.y.left = element_text(face="bold", size=14),
      strip.text.x = element_text(face="bold", size=13)
    )
}

p_thresh <- mk_box_both(c("HRDT Thresh", "RRST Thresh"), "Interoceptive sensitivity")
ggsave("~/Git/InteroMentalHealth/figures/Intero_correlations/Psychsumscores_correlations/HRDT_RRST_thresh_boxplots.png",
       p_thresh, width=14, height=9, units="in", dpi=300)
```

# quantile correlation analysis
```{r}
quantile_rules <- list(
  "AQ10"        = ~ AQ10 >= quantile(AQ10, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
  "ASRS.A"      = ~ ASRS.A >= quantile(ASRS.A, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), # only 1-4
  "MDI"         = ~ MDI >= quantile(MDI, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
  "PHQ9"        = ~ PHQ9 >= quantile(PHQ9, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
  "PHQ15"       = ~ PHQ15 >= quantile(PHQ15, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
  "PSS"         = ~ PSS >= quantile(PSS, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
  "SIAS"        = ~ SIAS >= quantile(SIAS, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
  "STAI.trait"  = ~ STAI.trait >= quantile(STAI.trait, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
)

corrdata_quantile <- corrdata

for (v in names(quantile_rules)) {
  expr <- quantile_rules[[v]][[2]]
  keep <- eval(expr, envir = corrdata_quantile)
  keep[is.na(keep)] <- FALSE
  corrdata_quantile[[v]][!keep] <- NA
}

# sanity check
sapply(names(quantile_rules), function(v)
  sum(!is.na(corrdata_quantile[[v]]))
)

cormatrix_full(
  corrdata_quantile,
  "Psych Sum Scores (Top Quartile)",
  "Intero & Psych Correlations",
  "~/Git/InteroMentalHealth/figures/Intero_correlations/Psychsumscores_correlations/corr_PsychsumscoresQuantile75_Intero_full.png"
)

# all quartiles
quantiles <- c(0.5, 0.75, 0.9)
vars <- names(cutoff_rules)  # the psych vars you want to threshold (AQ10, ASRS.A, ...)

for (q in quantiles) {

  corrdata_q <- corrdata

  for (v in vars) {

    x <- corrdata_q[[v]]

    # If variable missing or all NA, skip gracefully
    if (is.null(x) || all(is.na(x))) next

    thr <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(x, probs = q, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7))

    keep <- !is.na(x) & (x >= thr)
    corrdata_q[[v]][!keep] <- NA
  }

  cormatrix_full(
    corrdata_q,
    paste0("Psych Sum Scores (Top ", q * 100, "%)"),
    "Intero & Psych Correlations",
    paste0(
      "~/Git/InteroMentalHealth/figures/Intero_correlations/",
      "Psychsumscores_correlations/corr_PsychsumscoresQuantile",
      q * 100, "_Intero_full.png"
    )
  )
}
```
